title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：suburb　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suburb 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the planner ① reached the suburb that no citizen in the district would have noted, and he said the reaching was the whole of the year. The ② suburb, meaning the district itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a suburb, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ suburb in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ suburb at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A suburb, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the planner said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the suburb was the whole of the matter, meaning the quiet and not the district. The ⑥ suburb, meaning the quiet and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; suburb, he said, is either something you reach or the only word that means both a district and a quiet. He said the quiet is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ suburb had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ suburb of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of noting; suburb, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ suburb I remember is the district noted in the report, which closed in 1960 and is still noted as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ suburb, my mother said in 1962, is the only district that improves by being noted; every suburb, she said, is a quiet that has agreed to look like a district. She said the quiet was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 郊区（指街区里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 郊区（指那片郊区本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：reach the suburb 到这一片郊区
D. n. 郊区（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 郊区之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的郊区之事）
F. n. 郊区（指规划报告里写到、被记下的那一片）
G. n. 郊区、清静（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 清静（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: reached the suburb that no citizen in the district would have noted
The suburb, meaning the district itself and not the plan
the suburb at the far square
the suburb was the whole of the matter
the suburb had become a line in a report
The suburb of the whole thing
A suburb, my mother said in 1962

answers.why: reach the suburb 意为“到这一片郊区”，1953 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯记下的一片郊区做了一遍。
suburb 意为“郊区”，指那片郊区本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记下。
suburb 意为“郊区”，指街区里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
suburb 意为“郊区”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
suburb 意为“郊区、清静”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片清静就是那件事的全部。
suburb 意为“清静”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片郊区，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
suburb 意为“郊区”，指规划报告里写到、被记下的那一片，到 1958 年这一片成了规划报告里的一行。
suburb 意为“郊区之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的郊区之事是一处街区和三个年份的记下。
suburb 意为“郊区”，我记得的是规划报告里记下过的那一片，1960 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一片。
suburb 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，郊区是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的郊区。

那片郊区，指的是那片郊区本身而不是薄薄的图纸，经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记下。（suburb）
